data.gender_notes: Aryaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Aryan means 'Lion, Noble, King'. It is a Persian name with roots in the Arabic language. The name is derived from the Persian word 'arya' which means 'noble, kingly' and the Arabic word 'ar-rī' which means 'lion'. The name carries the power and strength of a lion, as well as the noble and kingly qualities of a true leader.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Aryan is believed to have spiritual significance in Islam. It is said to represent the noble qualities of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), such as courage, wisdom, and leadership. The name is also said to be a reminder of the importance of striving for excellence and upholding noble values in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Aryaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion, Noble, King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aryaan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
